observations.text: architecture-rules probe ran the whole architecture suite: 540 passed, 0 failed. Passed rows include core-rule tests parameterised UnderServices and UnderModules (ACoreTypeThatReachesTheApi_IsReportedWhereverTheCoreTypeLives(UnderModules), AModelThatReachesTheCore..., AnArchivedReadPathTypeThatReachesTheCore..., AParentPlacementKernelThatReachesTheCore (both), handler rules AHandlerThatSavesWithoutAwaiting / UsesTheServiceLocator (both locations)), and real-assembly non-shrink checks (TheAwaitedSaveRule_LooksAtEveryRealTypeItLookedAtBeforeAndAtEveryRealHandler, TheServiceLocatorRule_...). I could not inject my own offender types; judgement rests on the suite's own results.

Same probe: order pins HandlersOfATeamRefresh_RunInTheRegisteredOrder and HandlersOfAPortfolioRefresh_DropTheMetricsCacheBeforeTheRecordersRead passed. I could not swap registrations in Program.cs, so the fails-on-reorder falsifier was not observed. Probe output also cannot show whether any production file was edited, nor that the 540 include every pre-existing test unchanged; no baseline run was available.
